act_name: Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016 (Punjab Act XVI of 2016)
title: Protection orders
text: The Family Court may, on being satisfied that violence has taken place or is likely to take place, pass a protection order prohibiting the defendant from: (a) committing any act of violence; (b) aiding or abetting in commission of violence; (c) entering the place of employment or residence of the aggrieved woman; or (d) attempting to communicate in any form with the aggrieved person.
source_file: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016 (Punjab Act XVI of 2016)

act_name: Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016 (Punjab Act XVI of 2016)
title: Residence orders
text: The Court may pass a residence order: (a) restraining the defendant from dispossessing or throwing out the aggrieved person from the shared household; (b) directing the defendant to remove himself from the shared household; or (c) securing alternate accommodation for the aggrieved person identical to the status of the parties.
source_file: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016 (Punjab Act XVI of 2016)

act_name: Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016 (Punjab Act XVI of 2016)
title: Monetary orders
text: The Court may direct the defendant to pay monetary relief to meet the expenses incurred and losses suffered by the aggrieved woman and child as a result of violence, including medical expenses and loss of earnings.
